description.en: A diamond sparkling in a bed of gold, framed by granules. This ring is a special gift, a token of love to be worn day by day.  The ring is made in gold 900 with a 0,03 carat fair diamond from Botswana. Would you prefer the shine of a different gemstone or a bigger diamond? Everything is possible, please contact me.
